item.title: Magic president Weltman not pleased with state of team after NBA trade deadline
item.description: Magic president of basketball operations Jeff Weltman spoke with Orlando media after Thursday's NBA trade deadline. The franchise only made one trade when it sent Tyus Jones to Charlotte.

item.title: Florida residents file petition asking court to stop DeSantis’ redistricting effort
item.description: The governor's actions violate Florida’s “strict separation of powers doctrine,” according to the petition, which was filed by a national firm based in Washington, D.C. that specializes in voting rights litigation.

item.title: Daily Horoscope for February 06, 2026
item.description: Gentle words can still carry real weight. At midday, the Moon squares expansive Jupiter, stretching patience as feelings bump against limits in family matters or group efforts. By 5:48 pm EST, talkative Mercury steps into Pisces, which reminds us to encourage one another's exploration of imagination. With Mercury leveling up our empathy, we can mend misunderstandings, revive stalled conversations, and let intuition guide timing. Progress sticks when compassion ensures that everyone gets heard. C

item.title: A funeral home stashed 189 decaying bodies and handed out fake ashes. His mother was among them

item.title: Beede’s Breakdown: Magic handle business vs. Nets following trade deadline
item.description: After snapping a two-game losing streak against the Nets just hours after the NBA trade deadline, the Magic remain at home when they host the Jazz on Saturday.

item.title: Lightning rout Panthers 6-1 as fists fly in final game before break
item.description: A dustup at 4:06 of the third period saw all 11 skaters on the ice given penalties while Florida coach Paul Maurice was ejected.

item.title: Orlando high school scores and statistics from Thursday, Feb. 5
item.description: Girls soccer regional winners included Timber Creek, Celebration, Innovation and Oviedo, while Oak Ridge won in girls hoops district play. Boys basketball district winners included Seminole, University (Orlando), Winter Park and Dr. Phillips.
